    @property
    def device_state_attributes(self):
        attr = super().device_state_attributes
        # remove HVAC setpoint attributes
        set_req = self.gateway.const.SetReq
        for val in (set_req.V_HVAC_SETPOINT_COOL, set_req.V_HVAC_SETPOINT_HEAT):
            attr.pop(set_req(val).name, None)
        return attr

Thus UI will not show duplicates.
